title: Store Pickup Reference Card for Ridgeline Orders & Delivery
content:
Pickup orders under Ridgeline Orders & Delivery are held at the store for a set number of calendar days after the ready date before they are cancelled, and the hold may be extended once on request, before it lapses, by the program's extension days. The collection options open to the customer depend on the fulfillment program.

| | Ridgeline Ship to Home | Ridgeline Buy Online Pick Up In Store | Ridgeline Ship to Store | Ridgeline Same-Day Delivery | Ridgeline Scheduled Truck Delivery | Ridgeline Appliance Delivery and Haul-Away |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Hold after the ready date (calendar days) | 0 | 7 | 7 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| One extension on request (calendar days) | 0 | 3 | 3 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Curbside pickup offered | No | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |
| Store pickup locker offered | No | Yes | No | No | No | No |
| A person named by the customer may collect | No | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |
| Photo ID matching the order or the named alternate required | No | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |

## Card notes

- **Collection by another person.** Where the card shows "Yes", a person named by the customer may collect the order instead of the customer.
- **Photo ID.** Where the card shows "Yes", the person collecting shows photo ID matching the order, or matching the named alternate when the alternate collects.
- **Locker and curb.** Only Ridgeline Buy Online Pick Up In Store offers a store pickup locker; Ridgeline Buy Online Pick Up In Store and Ridgeline Ship to Store both offer curbside pickup.

## Hold dates in practice (illustrative ready date)

A Ridgeline Buy Online Pick Up In Store order that became ready on 2026-05-11 is held through 2026-05-18, seven calendar days later. If the one extension is requested before the hold lapses, the last day becomes 2026-05-21, three calendar days later. A Ridgeline Ship to Store order with the same ready date is held to the same dates, since both programs set 7 hold days and 3 extension days.
